description:
The addendum schema-version test reads versioned fixtures and schemas at literal paths inside zen3 `dev/active/` entries. It locates them through one runtime-resolved repository root or by content identity.

## Background

Reader: `dev/tools/tuning-campaign-support/tests/addendum_schema_versions.rs:35-52`, covering fixtures in 26465e6c, eda07788 and 5cbb6545 and schemas in f547c394.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The test locates each fixture and schema without a literal `dev/active/` path.
- [hard] REQ-02: Before the change, a linked baseline record lists the test's per-fixture results with the exact command and commit; after the change, the results are identical.
- [hard] REQ-03: No historical-path allow-list or hard-coded `dev/` path remains in the changed consumer; code review checks the change against `@/inv/no-dev-path-coupling`.
- [hard] REQ-04: No fixture or committed receipt changes, and the Rust CI gate passes.
title: Locate addendum schema test inputs through the configured repository root
